messages.subject: Error in getMethod("coef", "lavaan.mi") - no method found for function 'coef' and signature lavaan.m
parts:
Hi, 

I'm having an issue with R and the lavaan package. I hope someone in this group can help me out. I have searched the web for this error but the information is scarse and doesn't help my case.

Here are the details:

1. I'm running R v3.4.1 on Mac OS X 10.11.6

sessionInfo() outputs:
R version 3.4.1 (2017-06-30)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin15.6.0 (64-bit)
Running under: OS X El Capitan 10.11.6

2. Packages installed (info via sessionInfo()):

semTools_0.4-15.910
lavaan_0.6-1.1141
devtools_1.13.3

3. I'm trying to run the function runMI()

The error I get is the following:

"Error in getMethod("coef", "lavaan.mi") : 
  no method found for function 'coef' and signature lavaan.mi"

Can someone please help me on how to fix this error?

Any help will be appreciated.

Thanks.
K.

messages.subject: Re: Error in getMethod("coef", "lavaan.mi") - no method found for function 'coef' and signature lavaan.m
parts:
"Error in getMethod("coef", "lavaan.mi") : 
  no method found for function 'coef' and signature lavaan.mi"

This indicates R cannot find the coef() method defined in in the semTools package.  Does the problem go away when you restart R and try loading the package again?  I can run the ?runMI help page examples without any problems, using the same software you reported, so I would need to see a minimal script and data to figure out what is causing a problem in your case.

messages.subject: Re: Error in getMethod("coef", "lavaan.mi") - no method found for function 'coef' and signature lavaan.m
parts:
This startup output bothers me:

[Workspace restored from /Users/Katherina/.RData]

It looks like you are using RStudio, which has default settings to automatically save your workspace when you shutdown RStudio, then load it automatically when you start RStudio in the same directory.  That can have unintended negative consequences, such as loading the same namespaces that were loaded before (sometimes preventing proper re-installation, or loading an irrelevant package that also has a coef method that is competing with semTools for some reason).

Click on Tools --> Global options... , and in the General tab, do 2 things:
  1. uncheck the box that says "Restore .RData into workspace at startup
  2. Choose "Never" in the drop-down menu next to "Save workspace to .RData on exit"
Then shut down and restart RStudio.  You can delete the (probably hidden) .RData file from your directory, if you feel like it -- it serves no purpose unless you want to save something specific, which should be in your R scripts rather than something automatic that RStudio does without asking you first.

When you have restarted RStudio, run sessionInfo() first thing to make sure nothing is attached except the base packages:

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

Then run library(semTools), which will automatically load lavaan.  There should be no need to re-install the latest versions of software that are already installed.  After running your script in this fresh session, do you still get the error message about not finding coef()?

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
